brief: Explain optical bench setup and trace records.

documents.name: alignment.md
documents.text:
# Optical bench
## Seating
Lock the prism into a brass cradle.
## Baseline
Allow the lamp 14 minutes to stabilize.
## Aperture
Set the slit width to 2 millimeters.
## Alignment
Use a green reference card.

documents.name: traces.md
documents.text:
# Trace handling
## Capture
Save 6 traces for each specimen.
## Approval
The shift physicist initials the trace bundle.
## Export
Write the final spectrum as TSV.
## Disposal
Retain calibration scraps for 18 days.
